title: Looking for illustrator for new merch artwork

author: theboxplymouth
title: Artist Commission for Tides & Tales project
content: OPPORTUNITY CALLOUT: ARTIST COMMISSION 🌊🎙️📦 @take_a_part_uk are looking for an artist-producer (or collective) to lead 'Tides & Tales', a multidisciplinary arts and heritage project for the East End community of Plymouth. Total Commission: £16,000 (£12,000 artist fee @ £300/day for 40 days + £4,000 materials/production) Delivery Window: November 2026 – March 2027 EOI Deadline: Friday 23 October 2026 Send your CV, a 2-page outline proposal, and work samples to kim@takeapart.org.uk by 23 October.
